abort.no_devices_found: No new IRSAP radiators found by Bluetooth. Close the IRSAP NOW app, move closer to the radiator (or to a Bluetooth proxy) and try again.

init.title: IRSAP options
init.description: The Comfort temperature is written back to the radiator when you set the mode to Auto (the radiator program resumes). Heat is the timed mode: it heats to the timed temperature for the given number of hours, then the program resumes (0 hours = no expiry). The polling interval is how often Home Assistant connects to read the state.

data.boost_hours: Timed mode duration in hours (0 = no expiry)
